Reflux and distillate flows essentially zero (sporadic 0.1-2.0 L/h blips), ratio 0 — no reflux or product takeoff established
Column profile flat (~64-75 °C) with oscillating, non-progressing wave; no separation gradient developing
Pressure drops steady at 0.6-0.8 / 2.6-3.1 mbar, low, consistent with little vapour traffic
